explanation: Q² = -0.5 GeV² is unphysical. In exclusive eta electroproduction, Q² is the squared magnitude of the virtual photon four-momentum transfer and must be positive. The borntest subroutine would compute cthe = 1.d0 - (-0.5)/(2*bmom*bmom_prime) > 1.0, causing acos(cthe) to fail (arccos requires argument in [-1,1]). Valid range for eta production: Q² ∈ [0.3, 5.0] GeV². Other parameters are physically valid: W = 1.7 GeV (above η threshold ~1.485 GeV), cos(θ*) = 0 (within [-1,1]), φ* = 90° (valid angle).
